2743.title: New-thread base branch resets after route navigation
2743.rootCauseOneLine: The branch hook keeps its selection only in component-local React state, which a route change destroys.
2743.proposedFix: Retain the new-thread branch selection and its project-environment scope key in memory across composer remounts.
2743.caveats: The focused test verifies the exact state reset without a live browser session.
